description: Mixed-support search is unresolved on the whole informative region: both meshes report not converged at all 256 nodes with r <= 2.145 and converged only to the pure candidate (1,-1) for r >= 2.15. Single start (uniform weights, v = 0.5), replicator update with beta = 40 and 150 iterations; at the observed gap of about 2e-3 the pruning threshold needs more than 160 iterations, so the budget stops the search. Non-converged nodes are not written as open rows in correspondence.csv (manifest open_rows = 23). mixed_supports.csv lacks starts, iteration counts, stopping condition, attempt history and a simplex residual; off_support_gain_bound is a mesh maximum, not a bound. The sentence 'They found no mixed equilibrium' is therefore unsupported under spec 10.3.
recommended_action: Rerun the mixed search with a convergence-based budget (or documented stall), at least three independent starts (uniform; mass near q = 1; mass near q = 0; v in {0.1, 0.5, 0.9}), solve the indifference/simplex system at the final support, write an open row per unresolved node, add columns init_id, iterations, stop_reason, final_gap, simplex_residual, quadrature_error to mixed_supports.csv. If this cannot be completed within scope, delete the sentence at main.md:294 and state that the mixed search is unresolved.

description: C.6 unresolved bookkeeping: per-node diag (skipped_searches, mixed_search, pure_unconverged) is never written; 470 of 497 unresolved reserve nodes have no reason in any CSV. A local |Psi| minimum that is not a root is labelled open whenever validation fails (minima up to 4.2e-2 at 27 class-economy nodes), whereas C.2 labels the same outcome rejected above 1e-4; neither uses a 'no candidate' category. search_unresolved = unresolved or not acc conflates an all-rejected node with an unconverged search (latent: no zero-accepted nodes in data). Table 4 Panel C's 'unresolved' counts inherit these conflations.
recommended_action: Add unresolved_reason, skipped_searches (analytical exclusion text), n_rejected, n_open, n_no_candidate columns to reserve_ranges.csv from the per-node diag; separate no_candidate from search_unresolved; adopt one tangency rule in both exercises tied to the Psi quadrature error estimate rather than a fixed 1e-4 or none; re-render Table 4 Panel C from the enriched ledger.

description: Duplicate accepted rows in correspondence.csv: strength 1.6 was solved twice under labels '1.6' (mesh) and '1.60' (certificate bracket string), giving duplicate pooling and asymmetric rows with different existence_status for the same root; at r = 1.51 the same asymmetric root is recorded twice (sign-change root and |Psi|-minimisation root, no dedupe between the two paths). Manifest nodes_with_multiplicity = 85 versus 84 distinct strengths and asymmetric_accepted_nodes is stale after the post-processing relabel. multiplicity_found counts accepted rows, not deduplicated continuations. Shaded span unaffected in the data (pooling coexists at both nodes).
recommended_action: Normalise grid keys through Decimal.normalize before solving; deduplicate candidates across all search paths on (orders, E, R_T) within a stated tolerance, keeping raw attempts in a separate attempts file; recompute multiplicity_found and manifest counts; keep the certificate-node row labelled computer-assisted.

description: Continuation identity keys on orders only; pricing is the raw-posterior inversion and validate(price_pools=True) supports one pool family (zero-entry preimage at t_0). No pricing_family_coverage or exhaustive_pricing_search fields; no alternative cutoff enumeration (spec 7.5). Not binding for C.2 (low-cost floor positive at every grid node, so no pool exists), binding for the C.6 sweep where zero-entry pools of mass about 0.5 appear at p >= 7.95 and branch changes occur inside the class economy's low band.
recommended_action: Concurrent price-pool/event work (spec 7-9). Identity must include the pool set and price atoms alongside orders; record pricing_family_coverage and exhaustive_pricing_search = false; rerun the affected reserve intervals and regenerate reserve_continuations.csv and reserve_ranges.csv.

description: Declared quadrature targets (1e-11, tightened by 10 on refinement) are never compared with the computed quadrature error estimate in any exercise; correspondence.csv and reserve_continuations.csv carry tail_bound but no quadrature error column. The refined pass doubles order intervals and raises the Gauss-Legendre order 48 to 64, which is not the declared x10 target tightening. Probe at r = 1.6: estimate 4.6e-18, so enforcement would pass.
recommended_action: Add quadrature_error to both CSVs; add a breach when it exceeds the declared target; record in the manifests that the x10 rule is implemented by the GL-order increase and state the refined error estimate.

description: epsilon_P compares the price schedule with the same closed form it was built from (tautological). The independent checks that actually gate acceptance (posterior_inversion_error, entry_independent_error) are not written to correspondence.csv or reserve_continuations.csv.
recommended_action: Write posterior_inversion_error and entry_independent_error columns; describe epsilon_P in the OA data dictionary as a consistency residual.

description: Figure 2 line styling: existence-status changes along the full-order line (numerical diagnostic on 1.678 to 1.805, J test to r_U, uniform bound beyond) are not styled differently; multiplicity shading spans min to max of flagged nodes (contiguous in the data, would over-shade if holes appeared); two accepted roots of the same branch at one strength are plotted as one sorted series.
recommended_action: Break or restyle the line at existence_status changes; shade only contiguous runs of flagged nodes; group series by (branch, root index) when a node has more than one accepted root.

description: Per-row best-response evidence for plotted rows is reduced to the scalar epsilon_q plus tail_bound; per-state argmax and gains from the 400/800-interval scans are discarded for C.2 and C.6 (C.1 writes them).
recommended_action: Write a compact per-row deviation summary (state, argmax_q, max_gain, quadrature_error) for C.2 and C.6, or a separate correspondence_deviations.csv keyed on (r, branch, q_H, q_L).

description: Mixed search lets only the favorable type mix and gives the low type its pure best response, citing OA.60 concavity. The premise (bounded nondecreasing residual) holds structurally for correctly signed supports but is never checked in the mixed path, and OA C.2 states that both types have independent probabilities.
recommended_action: Add the monotone-residual check (as in conditional_entry_cost_based) to the mixed candidate, record it, and state the restriction in OA C.2 and the manifest method string.

description: Pooling existence status outside the maintained domain is assigned from val.accepted rather than from the sign of the linear coefficient e0 Delta_T/2 - k that decides it analytically; classify_feedback's text says rho Delta_T/2 <= k while the margin uses e0; pure_search open rows carry no branch identity.
recommended_action: Derive the pooling label from the coefficient sign and align the wording; give pure_search rows the initialisation list.

recommended_action: Remove the line or replace it with the actual floor check tied to signal_margins.

description: asymmetric_discontinuity rows (Psi sign change across the plateau boundary, not a root) and non-root tangency minima are labelled rejected although no candidate was formed; 'rejected' should denote a validated candidate with a deviation witness.
